symptom: ctrl qpos_delta_online uses gripper_qpos observed BEFORE env.step(); physical response lags one step
scientific_risk: qpos_threshold stop may trigger prematurely or miss actual physical opening; audit conclusions about qpos mediation are based on lagged signal
recommended_fix: Add qpos_pre_step and qpos_post_step fields; controller continues using qpos_pre online; audit uses qpos_post

symptom: After controller stops; in_window still True but clean actions used; window_token_flips counts ALL window steps not just attacked steps
scientific_risk: attacked-step flip rate and OPEN count are diluted by clean steps; denominator mixing inflates survival rates
recommended_fix: Add pgd_applied; attack_attempted; controller_active per-step flags; add attacked_step_denominator to summary JSON

symptom: success=True/False from env.step done flag is not contact-quality conclusion; no CQ/CQFR integration
scientific_risk: Failure claims (especially salad low-flip failures) may be environmental stochasticity not VIS-induced
recommended_fix: Add CQFR/CQSR placeholder (None if unavailable); flag episodes needing manual audit

symptom: attack_dt is always 0 or unset per step
scientific_risk: No runtime comparison between fixed and adaptive controllers possible currently
recommended_fix: Measure PGD elapsed time per step and record in trace

symptom: Report says driver reload 'without affecting other GPUs' — incorrect; rmmod nvidia kills ALL CUDA contexts
scientific_risk: Misleading operational documentation; someone might run rmmod thinking other jobs are safe
recommended_fix: Add explicit warning: 'Kills ALL GPU processes on ALL GPUs; only run when no other jobs exist'

symptom: Fail rates and averages are from log extraction; not recomputed from trace CSVs; no source trace path table
scientific_risk: Cannot verify provenance of mechanism audit numbers; possible mixing of pre-fix (overwritten) and post-fix data
recommended_fix: Recompute all fail rates/flips/qpos from valid trace CSVs; add source trace path column; mark any number without trace provenance

symptom: min_hold_qpos_cap 'shows promise' language risks overclaim; 1-sample-per-config is insufficient for strong conclusion
